controls.regle: Each personal data processing activity is recorded in the register of processing activities, with its purpose, its identified legal basis, and its categories of data and data subjects.
controls.verification: Review the register of processing activities; verify its completeness against the processing actually carried out by the application and the presence of a legal basis for each processing activity.
controls.preuve_attendue: Excerpt from the register of processing activities covering the application + justification of the legal basis adopted for each processing activity.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = all processing activities recorded with an identified legal basis ; partial = incomplete register or unjustified legal basis ; non-compliant = no register
actions_audit: Identify the data processing activities actually carried out by the application and compare them against the register.
Verify the legal basis adopted for each processing activity and its documented justification.
If gap: complete the register and have the missing legal basis decided by the compliance officer.
standards: RGPD — art. 30 (registre des activités de traitement)

controls.regle: A data protection impact assessment (DPIA) is carried out, documented, and validated by the delegate/compliance officer whenever a processing activity presents a high risk to individuals; it is renewed with every substantial change to the processing.
controls.verification: Determine whether the high-risk criteria are met (nature of the data, scale, cross-referencing, automated decision-making); if so, verify the existence, content, and validation of the DPIA.
controls.preuve_attendue: DPIA signed/validated by the compliance officer, or documented analysis concluding there is no obligation.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = required DPIA carried out and validated, or absence of obligation demonstrated ; partial = DPIA started but not validated ; non-compliant = DPIA required and missing
actions_audit: Assess the criteria triggering the DPIA obligation with regard to the actual processing.
If required, verify the existence, content, and formal validation of the DPIA by the compliance officer.
If gap: initiate or finalize the DPIA before any broader release.
standards: RGPD — art. 35 (analyse d'impact relative à la protection des données)
RGPD — art. 36 (consultation préalable de l'autorité de contrôle)

controls.regle: The AI system is classified according to the risk grid of the applicable jurisdiction pack (EU by default: AI Act — unacceptable / high / limited / minimal risk), and the obligations corresponding to the level adopted are formally tracked.
controls.verification: Identify the system's functions that may fall under a risk category of the applicable jurisdiction pack; verify the classification adopted and its documented justification.
controls.preuve_attendue: AI system classification sheet (category adopted, justification, identified applicable obligations).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = classification documented and justified, obligations tracked ; partial = classification sketched without a complete justification ; non-compliant = AI system not classified
actions_audit: Analyze the system's functions with regard to the classification grid of the applicable jurisdiction pack.
Verify the documented justification of the category adopted and the resulting obligations.
If gap: produce the classification and initiate compliance with the obligations of the identified level.
standards: AI Act — art. 6 et Annexe III (règles de classification)
AI Act — art. 9 (système de gestion des risques)

controls.regle: Individuals interacting with the system are informed, in a clear, prior, and accessible manner, of the nature of the processing and, where applicable, of the automated or AI-generated character of the interaction or content.
controls.verification: Walk through the user interaction point; verify the presence, clarity, and accessibility of the information on the processing and on the use of AI.
controls.preuve_attendue: Capture of the user journey showing the information/transparency notice.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = clear and systematic information provided before interaction ; partial = information present but incomplete or hardly visible ; non-compliant = no information
actions_audit: Walk through the user interaction point and note the presence of the information notice.
Verify the clarity and accessibility of the notice (understandable language, visibility).
If gap: add or strengthen the information/transparency notice.

controls.regle: Only the data strictly necessary for the declared purpose is collected, transmitted, and retained; any additional field, source, or use is explicitly justified.
controls.verification: Compare the data actually collected/transmitted against the strict need of the declared purpose; identify any unjustified excess field.
controls.preuve_attendue: Map of the data collected with the associated purpose per field.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = data strictly necessary, deviations justified ; partial = a few unjustified excess fields ; non-compliant = widespread disproportionate collection
actions_audit: Map the data collected/transmitted and its declared purpose.
Identify the excess fields relative to the strict need.
If gap: remove or formally justify each excess field.

controls.regle: The rights of data subjects (access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability) are supported by a procedure that is executable within the legal timeframes, tracked, and not dependent on ad hoc manual processing.
controls.verification: Trigger or simulate a rights request; verify the processing timeframe, traceability, and completeness of the response provided.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented procedure for exercising rights + trace of a request processed within the timeframe.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = procedure supported and legal timeframe met, tracked ; partial = procedure exists but timeframe or traceability insufficient ; non-compliant = rights not supported
actions_audit: Verify the existence of a documented procedure for each data subject right.
Simulate a rights request and measure the processing timeframe and completeness.
If gap: build the missing procedure and train the relevant teams.
standards: RGPD — art. 15 à 22 (droits des personnes concernées)

controls.regle: Any transfer of personal data outside the originating jurisdictional perimeter relies on a regulated mechanism (adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses, appropriate safeguards) documented flow by flow.
controls.verification: Map the data flows leaving the originating jurisdictional perimeter; verify for each the applicable regulating mechanism and its documentation.
controls.preuve_attendue: Map of cross-border flows + regulating mechanism documented per flow (clauses, adequacy decision, safeguards).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = all out-of-jurisdiction flows regulated and documented ; partial = flows partially regulated or incomplete documentation ; non-compliant = out-of-jurisdiction transfer with no regulating mechanism
actions_audit: Map the data flows leaving the originating jurisdictional perimeter.
Verify the regulating mechanism applicable to each identified flow and its documentation.
If gap: implement the required regulating mechanism or suspend the uncovered flow.
standards: RGPD — art. 44 à 49 (transferts vers des pays tiers)

controls.regle: Each data category is associated with a defined and proportionate retention period, with an effective purge (automated or procedural) at expiry.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a retention policy per data category and test the effective execution of the purge at the declared expiry.
controls.preuve_attendue: Retention policy per data category + proof of purge execution (log, job report).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = periods defined and purge verified for all categories ; partial = periods defined without a verified purge ; non-compliant = periods not defined or data retained indefinitely
actions_audit: Verify the declared retention policy for each data category.
Check the effective execution of the purge at expiry on a data sample.
If gap: define the missing periods and instrument the automated purge.

controls.regle: A data protection officer or a compliance officer is formally designated, reachable by data subjects and by project teams, and systematically consulted on high-risk processing activities.
controls.verification: Verify the formal designation of the officer (appointment, published contact details) and their actual consultation on the project's high-risk processing activities.
controls.preuve_attendue: Designation record for the officer + trace of consultation on at least one high-risk processing activity of the project.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = officer designated, reachable, and consulted on high-risk processing ; partial = officer designated but not systematically consulted ; non-compliant = no officer identified
actions_audit: Verify the existence and publication of the compliance officer's designation.
Verify the trace of the officer's consultation on the project's high-risk processing activities.
If gap: designate the missing officer and establish their systematic consultation.
standards: RGPD — art. 37 à 39 (délégué à la protection des données)

controls.regle: The AI system has technical documentation covering the model (architecture, known limitations, performance metrics) and the training/validation data (origin, representativeness, governance).
controls.verification: Request the technical documentation of the model and of the training/validation data; verify its completeness and its consistency with the actually deployed system.
controls.preuve_attendue: Technical documentation of the model + governance sheet for the training/validation data.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = documentation complete and up to date, covering model and data ; partial = partial documentation (model or data only) ; non-compliant = no documentation
actions_audit: Request the technical documentation of the model and of the training/validation data.
Verify its consistency with the version of the system actually deployed.
If gap: produce or complete the missing documentation before any move to production.
standards: AI Act — art. 11 et Annexe IV (documentation technique)
ISO/IEC 42001:2023 — 8.3 (gestion du cycle de vie des systèmes d'IA)

controls.regle: When an AI system falls under an active AI regulatory framework, the deployer's obligations are addressed before going into service: fundamental rights impact assessment where required, information for exposed individuals, designated and logged human oversight.
controls.verification: Verify the regulatory qualification of the AI system, the existence of the impact assessment where required, the information notices to individuals, and the actual designation of human oversight.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented qualification + impact assessment (if required) + information notices + dated oversight designation.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = obligations addressed and tracked ; partial = qualification done, obligations incomplete ; non-compliant = system deployed without the obligations having been addressed
actions_audit: Qualify the system with regard to the active AI framework; attach the qualification.
Collect the impact assessment, information notices, and oversight designation; attach the proofs.
If gap: address the missing obligations before going into service.

controls.regle: A data breach notification procedure is defined and tested: breach qualification, notification to the authority within the regulatory timeframe, information to individuals where required, and a breach register maintained.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of the procedure, the trace of an exercise (real or simulated), and the maintenance of the breach register.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated procedure + exercise report + excerpt from the breach register.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = procedure tested + register maintained ; partial = procedure defined but not tested ; non-compliant = no procedure
actions_audit: Request the notification procedure and its last exercise date; attach.
Verify the breach register (even if empty, it must exist); attach the excerpt.
If gap: establish the procedure, designate the responsible parties, schedule an exercise.
